description: Carried the pot and kept the loaf off the notch.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured a finger and a half, ruled on the chain, and left the firing off.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said the loaf was the same shortness as before the ride.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Told the plot of the twins, paid threepence, and said he is not in tomorrow's Shrew.
name: William Shakespeare
